risk_if_not_implemented: Without Social Media & Social Networking Restrictions, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Agreements
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to require internal and third-party users to sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access.
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Agreements (HRS-07) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Social Media & Social Networking Restrictions (HRS-06.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Terms of Employment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to require all employees and contractors to apply cybersecurity and data protection principles in their daily work to enable secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Terms of Employment (HRS-06) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Social Media & Social Networking Restrictions (HRS-06.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with People applicability. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
